sample_unit: patients with T2DM analyzed (202 AI-HEALS, 189 TAU) across 45 community health centres

links.outcome: Change in HbA1c (primary outcome) and self-management outcomes over 18 months, AI-HEALS plus TAU vs TAU alone, in cluster RCT
links.effect: No significant HbA1c between-group difference at 18 months (adjusted MD -0.22%; 95% CI -0.54 to 0.10) or overall (-0.21%; 95% CI -0.48 to 0.06). Small overall improvement in diabetes-related skills (1.69 points; 95% CI 0.05 to 3.33).
links.quote: HbA  1c  declined in both arms, with no significant between-group difference at 18 months (adjusted mean difference, − 0.22%; 95% CI, − 0.54 to 0.10) or overall across follow-up (− 0.21%; 95% CI, − 0.48 to 0.06).

screen.reason: Cluster-randomized clinical trial evaluating the clinical and behavioral effectiveness of an AI-driven personalized health education platform (AI-HEALS) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus compared to treatment as usual.
